MATHEMATICS — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #16
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. What is 8 × 8? (1 mark)
   A. 65
   B. 16
   C. 0
   D. 64

2. In the number 3547, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 4
   B. 400
   C. 10
   D. 40

3. Which is greater: 1/4 or 2/2? (1 mark)
   A. 2/2
   B. They are equal
   C. 1/4
   D. Cannot tell

4. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 6 cm and 8 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 14
   B. 10
   C. 12
   D. 2

5. Simplify 6x + 2 + 6x. (1 mark)
   A. 6x
   B. 6x + 2
   C. 12x + 2
   D. 12x

6. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 12
   B. 36
   C. 42
   D. 24

7. What is 4 × 7? (1 mark)
   A. 29
   B. 28
   C. 3
   D. 11

8. In the number 3147, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 40
   B. 10
   C. 4
   D. 400

9. What is the square of 9? (1 mark)
   A. 82
   B. 81
   C. 9
   D. 18

10. Solve for x: x + 5 = 14. (1 mark)
   A. 5
   B. 10
   C. 9
   D. 14

11. What is 1/4 as a decimal? (1 mark)
   A. 0.205
   B. 0.25
   C. 0.025
   D. 2.5

12. What is the square of 11? (1 mark)
   A. 22
   B. 122
   C. 11
   D. 121

13. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 8 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 30
   B. 120
   C. 46
   D. 23

14. What is the square of 13? (1 mark)
   A. 13
   B. 26
   C. 169
   D. 170

15. What is the square of 5? (1 mark)
   A. 25
   B. 5
   C. 26
   D. 10

16. What is √16? (1 mark)
   A. 16
   B. 8
   C. 4
   D. 5

17. Calculate 31 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 31
   B. 31.6
   C. 37
   D. 31.7

18. Volume of a cube of side 3 cm is: (1 mark)
   A. 27 cm³
   B. 9 cm³
   C. 12 cm³
   D. 18 cm³

19. Calculate 15 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 15.7
   B. 21
   C. 15
   D. 15.6

20. What is 8 × 6? (1 mark)
   A. 49
   B. 14
   C. 48
   D. 2

21. What is 4 × 4? (1 mark)
   A. 8
   B. 16
   C. 0
   D. 17

22. Find the GCD of 49 and 61. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 49
   C. 2
   D. 1

23. Which fraction is equivalent to 6/8? (1 mark)
   A. 1/2
   B. 1/4
   C. 3/4
   D. 2/3

24. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 8 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 22
   B. 88
   C. 19
   D. 38

25. Calculate 19 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 19.6
   B. 19.7
   C. 19
   D. 25

26. Calculate 23 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 23
   B. 23.7
   C. 29
   D. 23.6

27. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 24
   B. 144
   C. 156
   D. 48

28. What is 8 × 5? (1 mark)
   A. 3
   B. 13
   C. 40
   D. 41

29. Find the GCD of 31 and 43. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 1
   C. 2
   D. 31

30. Calculate 27 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 33
   B. 27.6
   C. 27
   D. 27.7

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
31. Show full working: A trader sells 18 items at Ksh 90 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)
